related.label: 782: test chessboard feasibility with rectangle XOR
related.destinationExcerpt: 02Why are some boards impossible?What relationship can no swap repair? In 001 / 110 / 001, rows 0 and 2 are equal, and row 1 is their complement: every 0 becomes 1 and every 1 becomes 0. A column swap moves the same positions in every row, preserving equality and complementation. A row swap only reorders rows. A chessboard has only these two row types, so every original row must equal row 0 or its complement.How do we check this cell by cell? XOR (written ^) returns 0 for equal bits and 1 for different bits. The difference between row i and row 0 must agree in every column: board[i][j] ^ board[0][j] = board[i][0] ^ board[0][0]. Bringing all terms together gives this four-corner test.board[0][0] ^ board[i][0] ^ board[0][j] ^ board[i][j] = 0 (every i,j)This is the invariant: the XOR of the four corners of any rectangle must be 0. related.label: 51: choose, recurse, and undo in constraint search
related.destinationExcerpt: 022 · When can a branch stop?How can we detect an attack before placing a queen? A prefix means the first r consecutive rows already filled. With exactly one column chosen per row, only three tests remain: column c, diagonal key r−c, and the other diagonal key r+c. For example, (0,1) and (1,2) both have r−c = −1; (0,3) and (1,2) both have r+c = 3. One step along a diagonal changes both coordinates by +1 (preserving the difference), or one by +1 and the other by −1 (preserving the sum).Keep the three kinds of occupied keys in sets cols, down, and up. If a new square hits any set, an existing queen attacks it; adding later queens cannot remove that attack, so this entire branch can stop. Pruning means skipping such a prefix. #51：在约束搜索中选择、递归和撤销
related.destinationExcerpt: 022 · 何时停止一条分支？怎样在放下一个皇后前知道它一定冲突？“前缀”指已经填好的连续前 r 行。固定每行只选一列后，只剩三项检查：列 c、斜线键 r−c、另一斜线键 r+c。例如 (0,1) 与 (1,2) 的 r−c 都为 −1；(0,3) 与 (1,2) 的 r+c 都为 3。同行沿对角线移动一步时，两个坐标同时加 1（差不变），或一加一减（和不变）。把已用的三个键分别放进 cols、down、up 集合。新位置只要命中一个集合，就已有皇后攻击它，后面再放皇后也无法消除这次攻击，所以整条分支可以剪掉。“剪枝”就是不再探索这样的前缀。如果都没命中，只说明当前合法，并不保证最终有解：n=4 时前缀 [0,2] 就无法填下一行。不变式：每次进入 search(r)，placement 恰好记录前 r 行的合法列；三个集合恰好是这些皇后的 c、r−c、r+c。回溯就是探索一个选择后，删掉它的列和三个键，恢复尝试前的状态，再试下一列。#37 · 看另一种约束搜索与撤销
